import subprocess, sys

LIM = 32 * 1024 * 1024
rows_small = '{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}'

def go(data, expect_n):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=180)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:500]
    out = [l for l in p.stdout.decode().split("\n") if l.strip()]
    assert len(out) == expect_n, (len(out), expect_n)
    return out

# exactly at the limit (whitespace-only, but on the boundary) -> E_JSON
data = (rows_small + "\n").encode() + b" "*LIM + b"\n" + (rows_small + "\n").encode()
res = go(data, 3)
print("boundary 32MiB exactly:", res)
assert json.loads(res[0])["safe"] is True
assert json.loads(res[1]) == {"error":"E_JSON"}, res[1]
assert json.loads(res[2])["safe"] is True

# one byte over -> E_LIMIT
data = (rows_small + "\n").encode() + b" "*(LIM+1) + b"\n" + (rows_small + "\n").encode()
res = go(data, 3)
print("boundary 32MiB+1:", res)
assert json.loads(res[1]) == {"error":"E_LIMIT"}, res[1]
assert json.loads(res[2])["safe"] is True

# a genuinely large VALID line (deep-ish request) nearly 32MiB
big_inputs = [[[7]*32]*128]*8   # 8*128*32 values
row = json.dumps({"op":"replay","inputs":big_inputs,"slots":16,"window":16,"events":[]})
print("valid large line size:", len(row))
data = row.encode() + b"\n" + (rows_small+"\n").encode()
res = go(data, 2)
assert json.loads(res[0])["hosts"][0]["sent"] == 0
assert json.loads(res[1])["safe"] is True
print("valid large line ok")
PYEOF
python3 -c "import json" && timeout 300 python3 bigline_test.py
